faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our game server hosting services
faq.question1: How do I get started with game server hosting?
faq.answer1: Getting started is simple! Choose your game, select a server location, and follow our easy setup wizard. Your server will be up and running in minutes with our instant deployment system.
faq.question2: What kind of support do you provide?
faq.answer2: We offer 24/7 technical support through live chat and ticket system. Our expert team is always ready to help with server configuration, performance optimization, and any technical issues.
faq.question3: Can I modify server settings and configurations?
faq.answer3: Yes! You have full control over your server settings through our intuitive control panel. Modify game settings, install mods, and manage your server with ease.
faq.question4: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.answer4: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and cryptocurrency payments. Our billing system is secure and transparent, with no hidden fees.
faq.answer5: Yes, all our servers come with enterprise-grade DDoS protection included at no extra cost. Your server will stay online even during attacks.

ddos.description: Enterprise DDoS proxy for Minecraft servers. Built on OVH Game infrastructure with custom filters. Low-latency deployments in India and Singapore.
ddos.vpBuiltDesc: Enterprise-level protocol filtering designed specifically for high-concurrency server networks.
ddos.vpStealthDesc: Fully conceals your origin server IP, neutralizing all direct-to-host intrusion attempts instantly.
ddos.vpPacketDesc: Hardware-level deep packet analysis silently drops bot floods while prioritizing legitimate player handshakes.
ddos.vpGameDesc: Latency-neutral filtering algorithms ensure stable ping and a seamless connection experience for players.
ddos.vpPeerDesc: Strategic network routing across Asian backbone carriers for sub-millisecond data processing speeds.
ddos.secArchLead: Deep integration with OVH Game global scrubbing network, layered with our custom filtering rulesets.
ddos.secScrubDesc: Incoming data is meticulously analyzed through three dedicated scrubbing networks before reaching your server.
ddos.secFloodDesc: Automated hardware-level offloading mitigates SYN, UDP, and complex application-layer floods in real time.
ddos.secProtoDesc: Designed to natively interpret Minecraft structure packets, blocking malformed requests without disrupting legit users.
ddos.secReactDesc: Machine learning-powered anomaly detection activates custom mitigation pathways in milliseconds during peak spikes.
ddos.ctaBody: Protect your gaming community with enterprise-grade infrastructure. Immediate deployment and zero-downtime migration.
